description_en: Deletes personnel entities associated with a travel standard
description_zh: 删除差旅标准关联人员实体
kebab_example: aliyun btripopen travel-standard-relate-delete --from-group false --rule-id 6523763 --remove-list entity_type=3 entity_id=667104628 --x-acs-btrip-corp-token feth00jqwis --api-version 2022-05-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: TravelStandardRelateDelete

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to use the group travel standard. This parameter is optional. If this parameter is not specified, the system determines whether to use the group travel standard based on the unified travel management configuration
parameters.help_zh: 是否走集团差标【选填】，如果不传则根据差旅统一管控来判断是否走集团差标
parameters.name: from_group

parameters.help_en: The ID of the travel standard rule
parameters.name: rule_id

parameters.help_en: The list of entities to remove from the travel standard
parameters.help_zh: 差标绑定删除实体列表
parameters.name: remove_list

parameters.help_en: A header parameter obtained from the "Enterprise Access Credential" API (added in the header). In HTTP mode, you can use corp_token=value in the URL as an alternative
parameters.help_zh: header参数,由“企业访问凭证”接口获取（添加在header里）,http模式可以在链接中使用corp_token=value来替代
parameters.name: x_acs_btrip_corp_token
